heading: **1 December 2025**
body:
If the samples are ready, please drop them off and scan them into the log in G216 \-  please use the “Short Read Walkup and Aviti PoolSeq” box. This generates an automated email to the sequencing team letting them know there is a tube to collect.

Tube 1 (NT1869756B) \- 43.2 nM 147 *NT1869756*

Tube 2 (NT1870957A) \- 22.7 nM N40 *NT1870957*

Tube 3 (NT1872158I) \- 40.2 nM 147 *NT1872158 (B1, C1)*

Tube 4 (NT1873359T) \- 41.7 nM N40 *NT1873359 (D1, E1)* 

Each vial of the Rosetta cells is 0.2 mL ⇒ Aliquot into 20 uL each and transform by adding 0.3 uL of each plasmid.

Each plasmid is resuspended in 100 uL of NF water i.e. concentration \= \~40 ng/uL

![](assets/img/doc3-image5.png)

*Testing SELEX buffers for Hia5 activity*

NCAP-SELEX: 25 uL Biotin Buffer (70 mM KCl, 2.5 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM MgCl2, 1.5 μM ZnSO4, 50 μM EGTA, 5 mM Tris, pH 8, 0.05% Tween, 10 mM Biotin, 50 mM Imidazole, 6 mM NaOH) \+ 4.5 TF dilution buffer (10 mM Tris pH8 \+ 0.1% BSA \+ 150mM KCl \+ 10µM Zn \+ 50% EG ) *\[Salt concentration \= \]*

*82 mM KCl, 2.1 mM NaCl, 0.42 mM MgCl₂, 2.8 µM Zn²⁺, 5.8 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 42 µM EGTA, 8.47 mM biotin, 42.4 mM imidazole, 5.08 mM NaOH, 0.042% Tween-20, 0.015% BSA, 7.6% ethylene glycol*

HT-SELEX: 4.5 uL TF dilution buffer (10 mM Tris pH8 \+ 0.1% BSA \+ 150mM KCl \+ 10µM Zn \+ 50% EG ) \+ 5 uL DNA (no salt, DNA in water) \+ 8.5 uL 1.55X SELEX buffer (*155μM EGTA, 1.55mM DTT, 3μM ZnSO4 (no dIdC), 31 mM Tris pH 7.5, 119 mM KCl, 1.5 mM MgCl2, 6% glycerol*) *\[Salt concentration \= \]*

94 mM KCl, 0.71 mM MgCl₂, 17 mM Tris (pH \~7.6–7.7), 73 µM EGTA, 0.73 mM DTT, 3.9 µM Zn²⁺, 12.5% ethylene glycol, 2.8% glycerol, 0.025% BSA (+ DNA)
